integrity: A self-contained standard-library checker exhaustively reconstructs all finite face-poset incidences, the acyclic matching, integral Morse boundary product and a determinant-one minor. Inference from the exact CW attaching degrees is given explicitly in RESULT.md. Scientific independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary matching complex of the particular twenty-vertex graph J5 is determined. No theorem for all flower snarks; no implied relation to edge chromatic numbers; earlier unindexed equivalent work remains possible.
title: The flower-snark matching complex is a wedge of 62 six-spheres
